scenario: AITA for reducing my tip to compensate for a drink I didn’t order? (US) | So short story, at a restaurant today for lunch I got an entree and a glass of water (not fancy water mind you, just tap and it didn’t even have ice). My girlfriend thinks it was an asshole move and I think I’m not paying $2 for lukewarm tap water. basically I brought my cheque total to the $12.50 it would have originally been without the water added.
